description: A Flutter application entry point defining a simple app with a home page displaying a loading message.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Stateless widget serving as the root of the application, setting theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main screen with a title, displaying a loading message.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage managing the build method that constructs the UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the Flutter application, invoking runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in both MyApp and _MyHomePageState that describes how to display the widget.
